title: Nth-Metal
summary: Nth-Metal, also known as Ninth Metal, is a hyper-conductive metal native to Thanagar. Among the unusual properties of the metal is the ability to negate gravity, allowing a person wearing an object made of Nth-Metal; such as a belt, to fly.

sections.title: Overview
items: Nth-Metal, also known as Ninth Metal, is a hyper-conductive metal native to Thanagar. Among the unusual properties of the metal is the ability to negate gravity, allowing a person wearing an object made of Nth-Metal; such as a belt, to fly.

In addition, the metal can also speed the healing of wounds, increase the wearer's strength, and protects them from the environment and extremes in temperature by regulating its users' body temperatures (generating heat in cold environments and generating cold in hot environments). The metal also possesses innate anti-magical properties and can disrupt ghosts and spirits upon contact with their spectral forms.

sections.title: Background
items: Used as shielding around the engines of all Thanagarian Warbird ships. In ancient Egypt a Thanagarian spaceship made of Nth-Metal crash-landed, only to be discovered by Prince Khufu and his betrothed, Chay-ara. Constant exposure to the metal forced Khufu and Chay-ara into a cycle of reincarnation. In the 20th century, they were incarnated as Carter Hall and Shiera Saunders, the original Hawkman and Hawkgirl where they wore Nth metal belts, made with the help of the Thanagarian Paran Katar.

sections.title: Involvement
items: A sample of Nth-Metal appears as a captured artifact within the Nexus of Reality. Due to its presence, power pools will appear on the floor during the final battle that will provide Power if a player stands within them.

Nth-Metal is the core reagent for Artifacts. Once the player has acquired their first Artifact, they will be able to find Nth Metal as a rare drop from defeating NPCs and be able to get large caches of Nth Metal by completing the Vault and the Stabilizer Event. Nth Metal comes in various qualities, with rarer, more refined pieces granting larger amounts of Item Experience when used to fortify Artifacts.

sections.title: Heroes
items: As the name suggests, the Iconic Battle Suit, Nth-Metal Battlesuit, is laced with Nth-Metal.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Nth Metal is classified as a Transuranic Iron ore with an Atomic Number of 26 and an Atomic Mass of 676.
In the future, members of the Legion of Super Heroes wear flight rings made of an alloy of Nth metal called Valorium.
Carter and Shiera's son, Hector Hall, made a suit of armor made of Nth metal and took the name Silver Scarab as a founding member of Infinity Inc.
Hawkman and Hawkgirl's chest harnesses are made with Nth-Metal which is the source of their strength and ability to fly.

In its purest form, Nth Metal can change its shape at will and morph into different forms to suit its user's needs. Even refined forms of the Thanagarian metal can form symbiotic relationships with individuals that wield it.
Nth metal is one of five "divine metals" that will open a door to the Dark Multiverse; the other metals being Electrum, Dionesium, Promethium and Batmanium.

sections.title: Overview
items: Pets are summoned NPCs that aid the player in battle until killed or unsummoned. Pets can take the forms of robots, floating sentry turrets, orbs or elemental golems.
Powersets that include pet summons are Nature, Earth, Gadgets, Ice, Iconic, Mental and Sorcery. Other pets can be summoned through the use of trinkets or consumables.

The ranked-up Source Shard artifact, the Hear My Call ability from Ally: Emperor Aquaman and Arcane Battery ability from Ally: Zatanna can be used to boost the attack of combat pets except for turrets and allies. The M.E.R.C.Y. Amazotron Matrix also may boost the damage of Crystal, Fury, Exobyte-Attuned Robot Sidekick or Robot Sidekick and/or shield certain pets and allies.
Certain healing powers and M.E.R.C.Y. Restorative Module can heal pets as well.
Players can spawn a temporary Trinket pet sooner than their default cooldown when equipping a rank 200 M.E.R.C.Y. Attack Protocol and minimum rank 120 Dead King's Scepter.

title: Power over Time
summary: Power over Time (PoT) is a special buff that can be provided to group members by a Controller. It is represented by a green lightning bolt. The Power over Time buff restores 6 ticks of Power to group members within line of sight of the controller. A group member will lose the Power over Time buff if knocked out.

sections.title: Overview
items: Power over Time (PoT) is a special buff that can be provided to group members by a Controller. It is represented by a green lightning bolt. The Power over Time buff restores 6 ticks of Power to group members within line of sight of the controller. A group member will lose the Power over Time buff if knocked out.

Vitalization affects the power generation provided by the Power over Time buff. 10 points of Vitalization increases base power generation by 1%. Critical Power Chance and Critical Power Magnitude can also improve power generation.

Only one normal Power over Time buff can be active on a player at any given time. Normal Power over Time effects do not stack. If a second controller in a group activates a Power over Time ability, it will override the original buff.

Note that supercharge Power over Time abilities, such as Battle Drone, Word of Power or Bastion use a different Power over Time stack that does not interfere with the normal Controller Power over Time buff. Using a Power over Time ability while another buff is active does not stack and will override the current buff effect.

Normal Power over Time abilities provide 5 ticks of power after the initial tick. So there is a tick of power every 5 seconds over a span of 25 seconds. The Power over Time buff then must be renewed. If a player activates a Power over Time ability after 20 seconds, there will be a Double tick on the final tick.

Bold Number = Second that Power is provided

title: PvP Combat Rating
summary: PvP Combat Rating is a statistic possessed by player characters representing the overall power of their PvP equipment. The PvP Combat Rating is calculated by averaging the item levels of all of a player's equipped items. It very much works like the (PvE) combat rating.

sections.title: Overview
items: PvP Combat Rating is a statistic possessed by player characters representing the overall power of their PvP equipment. The PvP Combat Rating is calculated by averaging the item levels of all of a player's equipped items. It very much works like the (PvE) combat rating.

sections.title: Background
items: The general PvP CR was so far increased with every major PvP update.
PvP Season 1 ( GU 25 - GU 33) had gear with PvP item level 77, 81, 82, 83 and 84.
PvP Season 2 ( GU 33 - GU 41) had gear with PvP item level 86, 87, 88, 89 and 90.
PvP Season 3 ( GU 41 -) has gear with PvP item level 96, 97, 98, 99, 100 and 101.

To be able to access the next gear tier at the PvP vendors, all gear slots in the inventory have to hold a gear piece of the previous tier. E.g. to get access to tier 2 PvP gear (item level 98), *all* equipped gear must be of item level 97.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Until 2013 the combat rating was considered a PvE only statistic since unmodded PvP gear never had an item level higher than 30.
Game update 25 introduced a PvP item level and now every player has a Combat Rating and a PvP Combat Rating.
PvP item level 101 (a.k.a. PvP tier 5) was introduced with Hotfix 04/08/16.
Modding did not increase a player's PvP CR. Prefab Mods were introduced for PvP gear.

sections.title: Overview
items: A Supercharge Generator power builds a large amount of Supercharge. They build an extra 150 Supercharge per cast (out of the regular maximum of 10000), plus any from hitting the abilities normally already grants which depends on the exact power used. For example, Horrific Visage yields 33 (183 total) and Relentless Anger yields 54 (204 total); different power sets vary from roughly 1/48 to 1/56 of the full bar per cast.

Supercharge is only gained if you use these powers in combat. They do not actually have to hit a target (e.g. Impaling Ice has relatively short range but as long as you are in combat, it builds Supercharge even if it misses entirely). Conversely, if you damage an object with a Supercharge Generator out of combat, you will not gain Supercharge.

sections.title: Boosts
items: Scrap of the Soul Cloak boosts Supercharge generation from both components, rounded down separately. For example, at rank 200, Relentless Anger will yield 258 Supercharge (190 + 68).

Ally: Black Adam can passively increase the Supercharge gained from Supercharge Generators by 15% - 35%. This only applies to the 150 bonus amount, and stacks multiplicatively with Scrap of the Soul Cloak, but Black Adam's bonus is counted and rounded down separately. For example, at max rank for both, Relentless Anger will yield 324 Supercharge (190 + 68 + 66).

sections.title: Supercharge Generator Powers
items: Birds' Blitz is a special Supercharge Generator ability granted by B.O.P. Commlink that is available to any players in the Controller Role.

Starbolt is one of the unlockable Iconic Powers that is not labelled a Supercharge Generator, but generates Supercharge on use, with different mechanics. While Supercharge Generators only yield Supercharge when used in active combat, Starbolt yields Supercharge as long as the player is in combat (role icon flashing red).

sections.title: Trivia
items: All Controller powers have a controller debuff power as their Supercharge Generator, although Gadgets are at a disadvantage because Stasis Field encases enemies, making it often undesirable.

title: Aggro
summary: When a player does damage, healing, and power restoration, the player will be placed on an enemy's hate list (aka hate table). An enemy's hate table has a specific order. Aggro is when the natural order of the hate table is overridden. Taunting increases a players slot on the hate table, Detaunting drops them to the bottom.

sections.title: Overview
items: When a player does damage, healing, and power restoration, the player will be placed on an enemy's hate list (aka hate table). An enemy's hate table has a specific order. Aggro is when the natural order of the hate table is overridden. Taunting increases a players slot on the hate table, Detaunting drops them to the bottom.

All Tank abilities taunt their enemies. Weapon attacks do not taunt, though they generate hate. Only the initial cast of an ability can taunt. Damage, Heal, and Power over Time abilties only taunt on cast. Same goes with Area of Effect abilities.
Dominance has nothing to do with aggro.

There are Single Target Taunt abilities which override even another tank's taunt, so that tanks have control over which of them is on the top of the hate table (the Lasso of Truth artifact makes Mesmerizing Lasso appear multi-target, however only the initial target receives the overriding taunt, the rest receive a standard taunt).
Certain Pets can taunt, such as a fully-boosted Sidekick. A tank taunt overrides this in much the same way as a single target taunt overrides another tank's taunt.

title: Arena PvP
summary: Arena PvP takes place in specialized instances where teams of various sizes compete against each other to complete different objectives depending on the competition being played.

sections.title: Overview
items: Arena PvP takes place in specialized instances where teams of various sizes compete against each other to complete different objectives depending on the competition being played.

sections.title: Overview
items: Arena PVP is unlocked at level 10. Players can queue for an Arena match using the On Duty Menu. Every match has a 2 minute warm-up period while waiting for all combatants to enter the match. Once all combatants have entered, the 2 minute timer will be replaced with a 30 second timer. When this timer expires, the match will commence. A match may start at the end of the 2 minute timer even when both teams have not been filled. All combatants are placed within their own safe room (one for each team) with a provided Sparring Dummy that also acts as a respawn point.

sections.title: Deathmatch
items: Points are gained by knocking out an enemy player. Once a team earns a set amount of points it is declared the winner. If neither team has earned the set amount when the match time expires, the team with the most points wins.

sections.title: Best of Five Deathmatch
items: Works like Deathmatch, but you need to score three times to win.

sections.title: Capture and Hold
items: Both team start with the same amount of points. A set number of capture zone or "nodes" are dispatched in the arena. To capture a node, one must be standing next to it, and wait for the progress bar to complete itself. If two players from opposite teams are standing in the capture zone then the area will become contested until one side is either defeated or leaves.
Once a zone is under a team's control then the opposing team's score will begin to drop. The first team whose score reaches 0 loses.
The difference between this mode and King of the Hill is that players are not required to stand on capture zone for it to remain on that team's side.

Points are also lost by getting knocked out by an enemy player. Once a team loses its points it is declared the loser. If a neither team has lost all its points when the match time expires, the team with the most points wins.

sections.title: Capture the Flag
items: Both sides are presented with an element to guard, which acts as that team's flag. Both team's objectives is to capture the other team's element and return it to their own base. If both team's element are being taken at the same time then neither side can score until one side loses their captured element.

Any player can pick up the element but when they do all their movement abilities (flight, super speed and acrobatics) are immediately disabled. If a player carrying the element dies or drops it, the opposing team can interact with the element and it will teleport back to their base.

Points are also gained by knocking out an enemy player. Once a team earns a set amount of points it is declared the winner. If a neither team has earned the set amount when the match time expires, the team with the most points wins.

sections.title: King of the Hill
items: Both team start with the same amount of points. A set number of capture zone or "nodes" are dispatched in the arena. To capture a node, one must be standing next to it, and wait for the progress bar to complete itself. If two players from opposite teams are standing in the capture zone then the area will become contested until one side is either defeated or leaves.
Once a zone is under a team's control then the opposing team's score will begin to drop. The first team whose score reaches 0 loses.
The difference between this mode and Capture and Hold is that at least one player must be constantly standing upon a capture zone for it to remain on that team's side.

Points are also lost by getting knocked out by an enemy player. Once a team loses its points it is declared the loser. If neither team has lost all its points when the match time expires, the team with the most points wins.

sections.title: Safehouses
items: There are three types of PvP battles that take place in the Safehouse locations (Police Stations or Nightclubs) for Heroes and Villains:

sections.title: Bomb Disposal
items: Each faction has a robotic Bomb Mech Suit standing in their (re-)spawn zone. One player needs to equip the suit and find the current location of the bomb - the white dot on the mini-map - and disarm it for 200 points. This needs to be done until 1000 points are reached or the time is over. The bomb location changes after every disarmament. The Bomb Mech Suits have their own set of power loadouts. Knocked-out iconic allies will also be marked with a white dot, but can be revived.

sections.title: Graviton Tech Recovery
items: Both sides need to fight to pick up the Graviton Tech in the middle room and transport it to a safe zone on their side of the safehouse for 200 points. This has to be repeated until 1000 points are gathered. KOs merely count for minor points.

sections.title: Rescue
items: Both sides need to fight to free hostages from their encasement for 200 points. This has to be repeated until 1000 points are gathered. KOs merely count for minor points. Iconics can be freed too to help in the fight, but will not count towards the score.

sections.title: Watchtower Assault
items: Headquarters Assault Battles take place in either the Hall of Doom or Watchtower and have three stages:
Stage 1--Secure the Perimeter: Consoles activate all around the area and players have to activate them while avoiding getting defeated by enemies. The team that wins Stage 1 gains extra marks.

Stage 2--Confront the Enemy: Each team has their own set of four iconic allies on their side which players must defeat. Once a team has defeated all four iconics, they advance to Stage 3, while the other team must still work to complete Stage 2.
Stage 3--Defeat the Other Team: First team to get to 1000 points from opponent kills wins!

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Batarang is a bat-shaped throwing weapon used by the Batman and his associates as a non-lethal ranged attack alternative to firearms. Through the years Batman has developed various Batarangs for various purposes, including a veritable arsenal of customized Batarangs that wailed like a siren, emitted smoke, exploded, acted as tracer beacons, amongst others. Batman also developed smaller Batarangs that worked like Japanese shuriken or darts, sharpened to cut into criminals' hands or arms in order to disarm them.

The earliest renditions of the Batarang were scalloped, metal boomerangs which were used to attack opponents and return to the thrower in one throw. Variations of these batarangs include those which were able to be folded for compact storage, those which can be explosively charged and those which are electrified.

title: Calculator
summary: Calculator is the mission control for villains, providing information and banter as the evil counterpart to Oracle. Ruthless and shrewd, Calculator takes delight in causing harm when there is profit to be made and power to be seized. He owes allegiance to no one, not even Lex Luthor.

sections.title: Overview
items: Calculator is the mission control for villains, providing information and banter as the evil counterpart to Oracle. Ruthless and shrewd, Calculator takes delight in causing harm when there is profit to be made and power to be seized. He owes allegiance to no one, not even Lex Luthor.

sections.title: Background
items: Noah Kuttler began his criminal career by crossing the country and getting into fights with various superheroes; analyzing and recording their battle tactics to ensure that he couldn't be beaten again. However, he ended up in prison serving nine consecutive life terms.

Kuttler escaped from prison and decided to reinvent himself. Hearing tales about a hero coordinator named Oracle, Kuttler turned himself into the Calculator; an "Oracle for supervillains". Being friends with several villains, he began to get people jobs and soon created a large network of information and connections thanks to his own intellect and information archives.

sections.title: Involvement
items: During the first instance in the Headquarters PvP arena, terminals that have been secured by Villains will have a hologram of Calculator hovering above them.
Calculator along with Oracle is an ally in the Brainiac: Hall of Doom alert.

sections.title: Villains
items: The Calculator offers mission information and objectives to villain players.
Calculator is a taskmaster for the mission Anti-Matter Matters during the anniversary event Attack of the Anti-Monitor.

sections.title: Heroes
items: The Calculator is heard issuing warnings in the mission in the Hall of Doom when the player attempts to liberate Superman.
The Calculator teams up with Oracle to hack into Brainiac's systems and trap him with his own bottling technology after Brainiac is defeated at the end of Batcave: Brainiac Sub-Construct.

sections.title: Associated Equipment
items: Beghilos Emblem
Info Broker Emblem
Calculator Uplink Device

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Calculator first appeared in Detective Comics #463 (September, 1976).
The Calculator is voiced by Tracy W. Bush.
The Calculator was initially based upon a popular trend, in this case the pocket calculator, which was released in the early 1970s.
Noah charges $1,000 per question answered.

items: Secret Society of Super-Villains
Oracle

items: Transform into a stealthy Canine with new powers and increased Power regeneration.

Muttabolism: Increase your canine metabolism, restoring Health to yourself and your group members over time.

sections.title: Notes
items: Fling can be used to spread and refresh Poison from Briar, Carnivorous Plants, Serpent Call and Vine Lash.

Pack Leader summon two Dogs for 20 seconds. It is used without power cost or cooldown when Canine Form is cast, so you can have up to four Dogs at the beginning. If you switch back to normal form, the initial Dogs will disappear but manually summoned ones will remain for the full duration.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Canine Form is the only Supercharge ability among all Powers to have a 2500 Supercharge cost (previously shared with Insectoid Form and Primal Wolf Form, which are now 5000 cost).

title: Corum Rath
summary: Corum Rath is a devote Atlantean extremist who believes that the Kingdom of Atlantis was once the greatest power on Earth and can be again. To further his ideals, Corum is the leader of The Deluge; a fiercely xenophobic and traditionalist terror cell that opposes Aquaman's progressive intentions to form a political alliance with the Dry Landers.

sections.title: Overview
items: Corum Rath is a devote Atlantean extremist who believes that the Kingdom of Atlantis was once the greatest power on Earth and can be again. To further his ideals, Corum is the leader of The Deluge; a fiercely xenophobic and traditionalist terror cell that opposes Aquaman's progressive intentions to form a political alliance with the Dry Landers.

sections.title: Background
items: Corum Rath grew up skint broke within the lowest tride of the Kingdom of Atlantis. He and his father, Callun Rath were both Hadalin, Atlantean masonries who spent their days toiling away building up the foundation of their home kingdom. A routine where in whenever Corum broke fresh stone for which, his father would give him a sound beating.

Callun eventually died of exhaustion, his broken body left alone in an unmarked grave. Signifying unfulfilled man who wasted his misbegotten life away for royalty who never even knew his name, leaving Corum alone within the Ninth Tride to fend for himself. As he set about the city in his youth, Corum found himself stifled by the seachanged Atlanteans who lived there. Entities who he would grow to curse and hate as Taintbloods, due to their appearance and the symbolism behind it.

Once hearing tale that Atlantis used to tower above the oceans and held power the world over, the fact that it now sits beneath the waves with the surface dwellers running things. A race he deemed disposable and inferior to Atlantean culture, filled him with contempt for his nation's dismal history.

Taking his people's acquiring fish-like traits as a defeat of their national pride, as well as acceptance of their watery confinement. During his orphan solitude he met up with fellow tride dwelling street urchin; Kadaver. Finding him practicing his unrefined craft in solitude, as to the high nosed practitioners of the Silent School turned him away due to his humble upbringing.

The two would muse about Atlantis having been the greatest nation on Earth in the past, detailing how it once ruled both land and sea and that someday, when their time comes, its towers would rise up out of the oceans to do so again.

Kadaver merely laughed at such a notion, thinking it'd be a miracle if the lowborn's prayers were heard. But the two friends made a pact on accomplishing said feat nonetheless. That they would make the highborn trides and all that they survey, their own and rule as kings of a whole new Atlantis. Eventually the two would grow up and went their separate ways. Kadaver becoming an enforcer for the mobster Krush, while Rath came to lead the Deluge against Atlantis's royalty and the Surface World.

sections.title: Involvement
items: Corum Rath makes a short incognito appearance in the cutscene before the final fight in the first part of the Stemming the Tide challenge.

He is behind the attacks in the raid Starro: Spindrift Station and appears in several cutscenes. He is not fought directly, but unleashes Morgwar against the team at the end of the raid while he escapes.

Corum Rath is the ultimate antagonist of Atlantis (Episode), having vastly increased his arcane power through unlocking of ancient, forbidden Atlantean sorcery, and moved to seize the throne of Atlantis.; He makes an appearance in the Atlantis: Royal Palace challenge, where the Atlantean Royal Court deposes Arthur and Corum Rath takes his place as king. He cannot be attacked directly, and after his minions are defeated, he unleashes the Crown of Thorns, trapping Aquaman and forcing Mera, Ocean Master and the player to flee.; He is the final boss in the Atlantis: The Throne operation. At the beginning he still can't be attacked, and instead he summons a Sea Beast against the team and breaks Aquaman's Trident of Poseidon. After it is defeated, Corum Rath raises Atlantis to the surface, proclaiming that he will hide no longer. He resurrects the Sea Beast and additionally summons Morgwar and other monsters against the team. Upon his defeat, he attempts to evoke dark gods in a last ditch effort, but is annihilated by Aquaman wielding a trident conjured from seawater.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Corum Rath first appeared in Aquaman: Rebirth #1 (August 2016). Both of the episodes where he is the main antagonist, Deluge and Atlantis (Episode), are adaptations of story arcs in Aquaman: Rebirth.

Devoted to Atlantis' ancient ways, Corum is a devout puritan and considers even "sea-changed" Atlanteans (Atlanteans with fish-like characteristics like skin, webbed hands or tails) as abominations that should be killed to preserve Atlantis' purity.

Corum was born in the Ninth Tride (Ninth House) district of Atlantis; the socially and literally lowest district of the city-state. The district is a lawless zone for rebels and iconoclasts, and a sanctuary for undesirables. Corum has many contacts with the district's criminal elements.
Corum's greatest supporter is Sergeant Urcell; a female Atlantean warrior and his devoted second-in-command within the Deluge.

As an Atlantean, Corum Rath can only exist outside of water for a limited period of time or else he will dehydrate, asphyxiate and ultimately die. A typical Atlantean can exist outside of water for around 2 hours before needing hydration.
The developers considers his portrayal in DCUO to be a demagogue - as a politician who appeals to desires and prejudices of his people instead of rationality.
According to the developers, Corum Rath does not fully control Starros in Stemming the Tide - merely using them through animal handling skills.

title: Cross Pollination
summary: Cross Pollination is a Nature power that becomes available at Level 9.

sections.title: Overview
items: Cross Pollination is a Nature power that becomes available at Level 9.

sections.title: Description
items: Create a wave of pollen to heal yourself and all allies within range, growing in strength with every target healed.
Power Interactions : Releases Pheromones, endowing allies with healing over time and making them ripe for pheromone effects.

sections.title: Details
items: Cooldown: 3s
Power Cost: 300

sections.title: Notes
items: Flourish spreads and refreshes Pheromones from Cross Pollination.
Roar consumes Pheromones from Cross Pollination.
Cross Pollination heals Non-Player characters including player Pets.
Cross Pollination uses a special mechanic that heals targets depending on how many targets are healed.

For example, if you are by yourself, Cross Pollination will only heal you once. If there are two other allies that can be healed in range, all three of you will be healed for the same amount three times at once. The number of allies is capped at 16. This means Cross Pollination is significantly stronger in large groups. In crowded situations (e.g. in some raids), the heal can be comparable to Bloom while not requiring a channel, being an instant heal with a short animation, although its range is much shorter (about half a screen when zoomed out and in bird's eye view).
Targets already at full health do count for increasing the healing on other targets.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Cross Pollination's cooldown used to be significantly shorter to the point it can be recast almost immediately after the animation finishes.

title: Debuff
summary: A debuff is the opposite of a buff. It is an effect that while it persists hampers the target in some way. Among other effects, debuffs frequently lower attributes, hinder the effectiveness of the target's actions, or cause damage over time. Sometimes the term debuff is also used to describe the act of removing buffs on hostile targets.

sections.title: Overview
items: A debuff is the opposite of a buff. It is an effect that while it persists hampers the target in some way. Among other effects, debuffs frequently lower attributes, hinder the effectiveness of the target's actions, or cause damage over time. Sometimes the term debuff is also used to describe the act of removing buffs on hostile targets.
Controllers use debuffs on enemies for group support.
Debuffs are the little red symbols under under the players or enemies names. Some of the symbols appear in the shape of a red heart, shield, and a red reticle.
The symbols come in a variety of shapes:
Heart(Healing over Time Debuff)
Lightning (Power over Time Debuff)
Shield (Defense Debuff)
Foot Print(Movement Speed Debuff)
Reticle (Damage Debuff on rare occasions, a Vitalization debuff)
Star (Damage Debuff)
There are three main debuffs:
Defense Debuff
Healing and Power over Time effects Debuff
Damage Output Debuff

sections.title: Unbreakable
items: There are certain encasements that cannot be broken by blocking. A player has to wait a certain period of time, or be broken out by a teammate in order to get out of the encasement.

sections.title: Captain Bombus
items: Captain Bombus, as the first boss of the H.I.V.E. Moon Base Hard Mode Alert , will have the red danger signal appear above his head, then he will encase one team member within range in a yellow translucent honeycomb ball, with a spinning axe hovering over it, while the captured character runs in place. This will do a small amount of damage over time to the encased individual, but will knock them out completely if they are not released in time. The encasement can only be broken by another teammate picking up the ball and smashing it on the ground one time. Throwing the ball will not break the encasement. Sodas can be drunk, and powers that can be used while controlled will work, though they will not stop the inevitable knockout.

sections.title: Captain Cold
items: Captain Cold, in the Rogues portion of the Stryker's Island Penitentiary, will slowly freeze a player, then encase them in a ball of ice. No damage is dealt. There is no way to break it, other than waiting; teammates can not help. Sodas can be drunk, and powers that can be used while controlled will work. Other than an annoyance, one purpose of this is to kill off players that do not stay with the team, since they will not be frozen and will be left to fight the Rogues by themselves while others are encased. It also separates the team, since the encased players will be bounced around the room, possibly leaving them in an exposed position when they are finally released from the encasement.

sections.title: Mister Freeze
items: Mister Freeze, in Arkham Asylum, after having summoned two gladiators which a team has defeated will turn up the cold and create an icy rain in the center of the room. Exposed players will see ice crystals forming on themselves, and if they don't roll (or slowly walk) directly into the fire of a burning furnace, will become encased in a rectangular block of ice that they can not break on their own. Teammates can pick up the encased friend and smash it on the furnace while they stand in the fire; it will take a good number of smash hits before the encasement breaks. Throwing, dropping, or shooting the encased team member will cause a glitch where the player falls through the bottom of Arkham until combat ends and the player can warp to rally via the map menu. Mental controllers should not use telekinesis at this stage, since it might fling an encased teammate and them completely out of the fight.

sections.title: Ice Pick
items: In Arkham Asylum, in the Mr Freeze dominated wing, there are NPCs that will shoot a freezing beam at a player and cause them to become encased in a rectangular block of ice. The only way to break out of this block of ice is for a teammate to interrupt the NPC, at which point the block will immediately break.

title: Rage Crash
summary: Rage Crash is the delayed damage mechanic resulting from using the Rage power Severe Punishment. Several Rage powers have mechanics that reduce or ignore Rage Crash damage.

sections.title: Overview
items: Rage Crash is the delayed damage mechanic resulting from using the Rage power Severe Punishment. Several Rage powers have mechanics that reduce or ignore Rage Crash damage.
Severe Punishment activates Enrage which temporarily heals incoming damage for 8 seconds. Rage Crash occurs immediately after the Enrage ends and applies all damage that had been previously healed.
Shields and Damage Absorption abilities can be used to prevent some damage from a Rage Crash.
Blocking during a Rage Crash does not reduce the damage.
Defense increasing abilities do not reduce the damage during a Rage Crash.
Heals do not prevent damage from a Rage Crash but can be used to restore Health after the Rage Crash damage is applied.

Rage Crash damage is ignored when performing attacks from Dreadful Blast, Eviscerating Chain, Outrage, Plasma Retch & Revenge including their combos. These powers or combos must be activated or immediately after the Rage mode ends in order to prevent the Rage Crash damage. Rage Crash will also be ignored if Enrage ends while in the midst of a Rage combo.

Rage Crash damage is reduced by 50% while the effects of Bloodlust, Galling Eruption, Lacerate, Remorseless Recovery & Violence are active. The reduction amount is not increased while under the effect of two or more of these powers.
Vindictive is a supercharge that provides immunity to Rage Crash damage while active.

title: Exobyte Steal
summary: Exobyte Steal is a unique Iconic Power unlocked via the Event Progression, currently exclusive to 2026 Patrol 1: Day of Reckoning. It is based on The Reckoning.

sections.title: Overview
items: Exobyte Steal is a unique Iconic Power unlocked via the Event Progression, currently exclusive to 2026 Patrol 1: Day of Reckoning. It is based on The Reckoning.

sections.title: Description
items: Fires a damaging beam at the target. The beam gives you up to 3 enhancements based on the Power Interactions on that target. Duplicate enhancements increases the enhancement's effects.
Exobyte Spike
Dazed, Frostbitten, Poisoned, or Polarized
For the duration, attacks spark an exobyte spike on the target, further damaging them.
Exobyte Explosion
Bad Karma, Burning, Plasma Burned, Purified, or Graviton-Charged
For the duration, attacks spark an exobyte explosion on the target that damages all enemies within its radius.
Exobyte Surge
Electrified, Terrified, Crushed, or Destabilized
For the duration, your stats are increased (per list below).

sections.title: Notes
items: Due to the diversity of enhancements attributed to different power interactions and extended cooldown time, this ability is better suited for group content against bosses.

Power Interactions that this ability benefits from:; Bad Karma is native to the Sorcery power set. Alternatively, players can use the consumable Karmic Hex.; Burning is native to the power sets Fire, Gadgets, and Munitions. Alternatively, players can use the iconic abilities Heat Vision and Magma Vortex, or the consumable Napalm Atomizer.; Crush is native to the power sets Earth and Water. Alternatively, players can use the Magma Vortex iconic ability or the consumable Formula of Crushing.; Daze is native to the power sets Atomic, Gadgets, Light, and Mental, as well as to the augments Blue Lantern Ring and White Lantern Ring. Alternatively, players can use the iconic abilities Batarang Multi-Shot, Gag Glove, Sonic Cry, and Bat Swarm, or the consumable Dazing Device.; Destabilize is native to the Quantum power set. Alternatively, players can use the consumable Chronometric Emitter.; Electrify is native to the power sets Electricity and Gadgets. Alternatively, players can use the Word of Power iconic ability or the consumable Electrostatic Pulse Device.; Frostbite is native to the power sets Gadgets and Ice. Alternatively, players can use the Freezing Breath iconic ability or the consumable Cryogenic Solution.; Graviton-Charge is native to the Quantum power set. Alternatively, players can use the consumable Graviton Accelerator.; Plasma Burn is native to the Rage power set. Alternatively, players can use the consumable Plasma Capsule.; Poison is native to the Nature power set.; Polarize is native to the Electricity power set. Alternatively, players can use the consumable Polarization Mechanism.; Purification is native to the Celestial power set. Alternatively, players can use the consumable Holy Light Vial.; Terror is native to the Mental power set. Alternatively, players can use the Scarecrow's Fear Bomb iconic ability or the consumable Ampoule of Terror.

Note that some power sets may benefit from this ability more than others. Most of them are only capable to activate 1 enhancement using native abilities only. Electricity, Mental and Quantum can activate up to 2 enhancements using native abilities only. The Gadgets power set has native abilities to apply all 3 enhancements.

Certain artifacts can prove beneficial when used with Exobyte Steal:; Grimorium Verum can be used as a way to passively apply a power interaction based on character's power set, granting more freedom to plan your loadout. At rank 120, Void Gazer applies interaction to a single target; at rank 160, it also applies it to enemies near its target.; If using Heat Vision to apply Burning, equipping a rank 160 Solar Amplifier artifact will also apply Burning to nearby targets.; For pet builds using Crystal, Fury, or Robot Sidekick, the M.E.R.C.Y. Amazotron Matrix at rank 120 grants the M.E.R.C.Y. Attack Protocol ability, which allows those pets to apply power interaction to multiple targets.

Certain allies can prove beneficial when used with Exobyte Steal:; Batman's Caped Crusade (signature) inflicts Daze.; General Zod's Kneel Before Zod (signature) inflicts Burning.; John Constantine's Ward of Zauriel (signature) inflicts Bad Karma.; John Stewart's Hardlight Turret Barrage (signature) inflicts Daze.; Mister Freeze's Eternal Freeze Ray (signature) and Frozen Heart (support) inflict Frostbite.; Shazam's Bolt of Zeus (signature) inflicts Electrify up to 4 enemies at a time.; Static's Electro Shield Punch (signature) inflicts Polarize.; Superboy's Heat Vision Sweep (signature) inflicts Burning.; Superman's Freezing Breath (signature) inflicts Frostbite.; Zatanna's Showtime (signature) inflicts Daze. Her Out of a Hat passive also benefits from the casting of abilities that apply Power Interactions.
Certain trinkets can prove beneficial when used with Exobyte Steal:; Hardlight Crash Out Elite Uplink Device inflicts Daze.; Subjukator Blast Elite Uplink Device inflicts Burning.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Originally, this ability was announced as: Exobyte Steal is a versatile Iconic Ability that adapts to your enemies and rewards strategic play. This targeted beam damages foes while analyzing their active Power Interactions, granting up to three unique enhancements that amplify your combat effectiveness. Duplicate enhancements stack for stronger effects, making Exobyte Steal a flexible tool that scales with encounter variety and playstyle. Depending on the interaction, you may trigger:; Exobyte Spike for sustained single-target damage; Exobyte Explosion for area bursts that harm nearby enemies; Exobyte Surge to temporarily boost your core stats, enhancing both offense and survivability.

title: Fortress of Solitude: Power Core
summary: The Fortress of Solitude: Power Core is the Fortress of Solitude proper. Constructed solely by Sunstone crystals, the fortress' power core is under duress from Brainiac's attempts to assimilate it to acquire the fortress' vast meta human power.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Fortress of Solitude: Power Core is the Fortress of Solitude proper. Constructed solely by Sunstone crystals, the fortress' power core is under duress from Brainiac's attempts to assimilate it to acquire the fortress' vast meta human power.

sections.title: In-Game History
items: See Raid T1: Power Core
Brainiac is corrupting the Fortress of Solitude, making it his weapon. Join Superman and Lex Luthor to purge Brainiac from the Fortress.

sections.title: Walkthrough
items: The Power Core is the most difficult of the three Fortress of Solitude raids. To avoid causalities along the path, tanks must draw several mobs to themselves at a time and avoid being swarmed by the whole crowd at once at all costs.

In the earlier parts of the raid sunstone fortifiers will be found floating above the mobs. They have the ability to render some of the mobs almost invulnerable, so interrupt and destroy them quickly.
The sunstone assassins are the most dangerous mobs in this raid. They attack with beams that deal around 1000 damage and are often found in clusters. Controllers must focus on keeping them disabled.

The first boss is either Bizarro, Supergirl or Power Girl. They are fairly easy to defeat. Bizarro and Power Girl's special attack involves using unleashing their flame breath or Freezing Breath respectively to deal heavy damage around themselves. Supergirl spins on the spot to draw players in. Upon defeat, they are freed from Brainiac's control.

After defeating the kryptonian, Lex Luthor and Superman sees through a transparent pane of crystal that the Avatar of Meta is sapping the fortress' eponymous power core. Luthor suggests they must liberate another weapon of Krypton in order to stand a chance.

After a corridor is the Phantom Zone chamber. Lex Luthor opens a portal to free General Zod, who will aid against the upcoming fights. The Prime Assassin appears. It is not too difficult but once in a while it would summon several pillars of immunity, affliction or restoration along with several sunstone assassins. Quickly destroy the pillars then the assassins, and continue attacking the boss. The Prime Assassin may also do a special attack by charging straight in a direction dealing heavy damage and knockback.

Fight through another narrow corridor, and after defeating the Prime Stalker Triad, you must transport a crystal to the end of the chamber, and defend it against Sunstone Sentries until it becomes fully charged and open the door behind it.

Afterwards, you would emerge back in the central chamber and find the Corrupt Jor-El A.I. boss. The key mechanic is whenever he starts pummelling the ground, debris would rain down with one piece being an interactable sunstone. Pick it up and carry it to the specified sunstone pillar. After a while, the Corrupt Jor-El A.I. will charge towards the pillar; he will grow or shrink in size depending on whether you fail or succeed. He takes greatly reduced damage while the pillar has a sunstone in it prior to his charge. If he is already at minimum size, he always gains size after pummelling the ground.

It is followed by a section where you are instructed to split the team in two. Typically, 4 players will go with Superman and Zod into the right path, and the 4 others go with Lex Luthor into the left path. You reach a chamber where one side will fight one of the remaining controlled kryptonians, who will retreat at about 2/3 health, while the other side fight generic mobs. If the side with mobs is defeated and the NPC ally is KO'ed, the kryptonian would enrage and easily defeat the players. The situation is reversed in the next chamber where the mobs side has to fight the final kryptonian and vice versa. Then, you have to fight both at once with all 8 players and deplete all their health to free them from Brainiac control.

The final boss is the Avatar of Meta. There are three power cores in the final chamber. Once in a while, the Avatar of Meta would begin to drain from one of the cores, becoming untargetable during this time. You must interact with the 2 other cores to overload them, while dealing with many lightning tentacles the boss spawns around them. The Avatar of Meta has a high damage stomp attack at melee distance, but at range, its most dangerous attack is Meta Mega-Blast, when it shoots a massive, slow-moving orange orb that detonates on impact, dealing 4000+ damage.
When the Avatar of Meta is defeated, Zod betrays the group, leading into Fortress of Solitude: Sunstone Matrix.

sections.title: Trivia
items: This raid was introduced with Game Update 5.
A glitch exists where, while attempting to access a Fortress of Solitude raid, the player might be teleported instead to a location outside of the Fortress of Solitude: Power Core map.

In the game's early days, Fortress of Solitude: Power Core was the ultimate challenge to the free player (it was released 9 years before episodes were made free to play), to the point it is very rare for a team to reach the final boss, let alone defeat it. Despite the combat rating requirement of 50/53, it was practically impossible to complete this raid without much higher stats. A full team of players with at least 65 CR was recommended.

title: Magic
summary: Magic refers to subjects that usually originate from other-dimensional planes of conceptual existence that are considered "separate" from Earth and are thus considered "Supernatural".

sections.title: Overview
items: Magic refers to subjects that usually originate from other-dimensional planes of conceptual existence that are considered "separate" from Earth and are thus considered "Supernatural".
Following the release of the Exobytes by Future Lex Luthor, Wonder Woman took on the role of mentoring the new Magic-based heroes while Circe took to mentoring the new Magic-based villains.

While "Magical Beings" are usually beings or "gods" that originate from an other-dimensional plane, "Magic Users" are usually terrestrial individuals who wield items or possess abilities that access other-dimensional energies. Both concepts are considered to be beyond the "common understanding" of Earth's scientific population.

sections.title: Homo magi
items: Homo magi are Earth-born humans that have a notable affinity to use magic. Homo magi are genetically identical to normal humans. The mysterious property that makes them Homo magi is genetically "dominant", as such the child of a normal human and a Homo magi will always be Homo magi. How and why this trait expresses itself has yet to be recorded.

The Homo magi originated on the continent of Kingdom of Atlantis. According to Doctor Mist, the continent was a focal point for unharnessed magical energies (known as wild magic), and the local Homo erectus evolved into Homo sapiens magi as a result of their exposure to these energies and generations of interbreeding with members of a humanoid extraterrestrial race known as the Hunter/Gatherers. Those beings who gained these nascent mystic abilities interbred for thousands of years, concentrating and strengthening the genetic predisposition and become a separate line of evolution known as Homo magi. Upon the fall of Atlantis, people who carried the predisposition of Homo magi spread across the globe. Today, any human being naturally capable of casting spells is considered a descendant of the Homo magi.

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Homo magi first appeared in Justice League of America #164 (March 1979), and were created by Gerry Conway and Dick Dillin.

Not all terrestrial Magic users are Homo magi.; Some are Half-Demons or infused with demonic energy like Etrigan, John Constantine, Witchfire, Kid Devil, Blue Devil, Felix Faust, Sebastian Faust, White Magician, and Raven.; Or Half-Fae like Timothy Hunter, Morgaine le Fey, and Doctor Occult.; Some are even Half-Endless, such as Rose Walker.; Some are humans in possession of powerful occult artifacts such as the helmets of Doctor Fate, and the B'Wana Beast, even Vixen's Tantu Totem, Ibis the Invincible's Ibis-stick or Sargon's Ruby of Life, and Bloodwynd's blood gem.; And others have been permanently "changed" by outside agents such as dimensional magics, gods or wizards as in the case of Shazam, Wonder Woman, the Enchantress, and Extraño.; Some have been bound to specific mystical locations from which their power stems, like Baron Winter (Night Force), who is bound to Wintergate Manor, and Barter (Hawk and Dove), who is bound to his shop.; Some are Elemental in nature like the Swamp Thing, Naiad, the Hat and Solomon Grundy.; Some magic-users are divine in nature, such as Circe and other gods like Zeus, Hera and Ares.
Atlantis is the undisputed center of magic on Earth.

Unfortunately, over the centuries magic users and magical beings have been hunted down by religious zealots who see the nature of magic as an affront to their religious views. Such incidents include the Salem Witch trails of 1692.

Dr Jana Bodie is a psychologist who specializes in magic-endowed patients. Her offices are located within an inter-dimensional space and is protected by magical wards to ensure it acts as a neutral zone between opposing factions.
While magic power comes in various forms, cold iron has the ability to resist and disrupt most magic, as does Nth-Metal.

sections.title: Overview
items: Mark of Legend

Marks of Legend, a form of currency, are awarded for participating in Legends PvE and PVP matches - either Arena PVP or Legends PVP. Two are granted upon a win, and one per loss. A few additional Marks of Legend are awarded from the introductory quests which lead players to Legends PVP.
Marks of Legend can be spent at vendors in the House of Legends, Watchtower and the Hall of Doom to unlock additional Legends Avatars for use in Legends PvE and Legends PvP.
Heroes and Villains can find Mark of Legend vendor Future Lex Luthor (Vendor) in the Archive of Victory area of the House of Legends.
Heroes can find their Mark of Legend station in the War Room area of the Watchtower, attended by Beast Boy. A second unmanned kiosk is located in the Reactor Core near Hawkman and Cyborg.
Villains can find their Mark of Legend station in the Pit area of the Hall of Doom, attended by Catwoman. A second unmanned kiosk is located in the Power Core near Black Adam and Captain Cold.

title: Mentors
summary: Mentors are iconic DC characters that guide the player through the base game by offering them missions and quests.

sections.title: Overview
items: Mentors are iconic DC characters that guide the player through the base game by offering them missions and quests.

Both Heroes and Villains have a trinity of mentors, each one is associated with a particular power origin ( Meta, Tech, or Magic). The choice of mentor dictates the missions players receive after the game's tutorial level but does not have combat-related effects nor have bearing on Episodes.
Mentor missions start at Levels 4 (right after The Awakening), 15, and 30.

table.caption: Primary Mentors
rows: Superman is the mentor who leads the New Heroes with Meta power origins. Heroes who ally with Superman will start the game at the MPD 3rd Precinct in Metropolis.
Lex Luthor is the mentor who leads the New Villains with Meta power origins. Villains who ally with Lex Luthor will start the game at Club L'Excellence in Metropolis.
Wonder Woman is the mentor who leads the New Heroes with Magic power origins. Heroes who ally with Wonder Woman will start the game at the MPD 5th Precinct in Metropolis.
Circe is the mentor who leads the New Villains with Magic power origins. Villains who ally with Circe will start the game at Sheeda's Den in Metropolis.
Batman is the mentor who leads the New Heroes with Tech power origins. Heroes who ally with the Batman will start the game at the GCPD 9th Precinct in Gotham City.
Joker is the mentor who leads the New Villains with Tech power origins. Villains who ally with the Joker will start the game at The Gotham Tap Room in Gotham City.

table.caption: Secondary Mentors
rows: Oracle is a secondary mentor for New Heroes. She acts as the player's guide; directing them from mission to mission during the initial storyline and beyond when key figures involved are not available.

Calculator is a secondary mentor for New Villains. He acts as the player's guide; directing them from mission to mission during the initial storyline and beyond when key figures involved are not available.
Martian Manhunter is a secondary mentor for New Heroes. He directs players to the various alert missions.
Talia Al Ghul is a secondary mentor for New Villains. She directs players to the various alert missions.
Hawkman is a secondary mentor for New Heroes. He directs players to the various PvP arenas.
Black Adam is a secondary mentor for New Villains. He directs players to the various PvP arenas.
John Constantine is a secondary mentor for both New Heroes and Villains. He directs players to acquire Artifacts and related items (and sells some of them back to you).

sections.title: Other
items: While under the heading of mentors, it is worth noting that the relationship between iconics and players is more akin to that of coordinators and their agents, as players aren't under their apprenticeship and are expected to be full-fledged heroes/villains.

sections.title: Overview
items: Mesmerizing Lasso is an Iconic power that becomes available at Level 10. It can be upgraded when the Lasso of Truth (Artifact) is equipped. The power is themed on the Iconic Super-Hero Wonder Woman.

A copy of Wonder Woman's Lasso of Truth, the Lasso of Truth was forged by the god, Hephaestus, from the Golden Girdle of Gaea that was once worn by Antiope, sister of Queen Hippolyta, and given to Hippolyta after hers was stolen by Heracles as part of his Twelve Labors. Empowered by the Fires of Hestia, the Lasso forces anyone held by it to tell and understand the absolute truth.

sections.title: Description
items: Lasso an enemy and pull them towards you, grounding, stunning, and causing damage over time.
Tank Role : Taunts a single target to attack you instead of others. The effect is more powerful and will not be broken by a standard Tank Role taunt.

sections.title: Details
items: Priority Taunt
Cooldown: 1.5s
Power Cost: 200

sections.title: Notes
items: Deals 3 Ticks of smaller damage after the initial larger hit.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Wonder Girl's Lasso of Lightning, which can electrify her enemies when triggered by her anger, was a gift from her half-brother, Ares. The lasso's energy stems directly from the lighting of Zeus.

Donna Troy's silver Lasso of Domination has the ability to impose her will onto those bound by it, thus forcing them to do as she commands, including speaking the absolute truth. The lasso's effect can be overpowered only by those whose will is stronger than Donna's.

images.label: Previously, Mesmerizing Lasso's starting effect has the player apparently throwing out three ropes.

title: Power Array Augments
summary: Power Array Augments are a category of Augments that work similarly to Artifacts, granting new abilities once equipped. They were introduced with the 15th Anniversary Event in 2026.

sections.title: Overview
items: Power Array Augments are a category of Augments that work similarly to Artifacts, granting new abilities once equipped. They were introduced with the 15th Anniversary Event in 2026.

sections.title: The System
items: Power Array Augments introduce small sets of abilities based on iconic characters with power sets that haven't been introduced to the game. Although they share similarities with Artifacts, they require much less resources and no risks to max out.

Players can equip their augments by accessing the Augments tab in their Inventory menu (character must be level 10 or above to use the augment). Each character has 4 slots dedicated to Power Array Augments, which are listed under their own subsection. They are listed by rank from highest to lowest, and augments of the same rank are listed in alphabetical order.

sections.title: Fortifying
items: When you acquire a new Power Array Augment, its rank is 0 and grants 1 ability. In order to make the augment stronger and unlock more abilities, they must be fortified on the Fortify tab in the Inventory menu. They are sorted using the same criteria as the Augments tab, except that any Augment equipped by the player will appear on the top of the list, and maxed out augments won't be listed.

To advance ranks, Power Array Augments must be fed Nth Metal. Upon reaching a threshold, they can only breakthrough by using Catalysts — they can be acquired from John Constantine at the House of Legends, the Watchtower or the Hall of Doom, or from the broker (if other players are selling them). The higher the rank, the more Nth Metal and catalysts are required to rank up.
Each Power Array Augment has four ranks, granting 5 abilities total.

sections.title: Acquiring Power Array Augments
items: On release, the only way to acquire Power Array Augments is via Event Progression. Players who missed those events have a second chance in acquiring PA augments by participating in the A.R.G.U.S. Strike Team event.

table.caption: List of Power Array Augments
rows: Event Progression:; Attack of the Anti-Monitor 2026; A.R.G.U.S. Strike Team 2026
Event Progression:; Hope Burns Bright 2026; A.R.G.U.S. Strike Team 2026

sections.title: Trivia
items: Initially, Power Array Augments had only 1 dedicated slot.; With the release of the Hope Burns Bright chapter, dedicated slots were increased to 2.; With Game Update 166, dedicated slots were increased to 4.
While similar to artifacts, they do not benefit from double artifact XP events.

Game Update 171introduced the following changes to fortification:; To reduce clutter, the Fortify tab no longer displays max-rank artifacts or augments.; Selecting a large stack of reagents will now only insert into the preview as many items as are needed to reach the next Milestone Rank. You can still select the reagents a second time to use the entire stack if you wish.
Prior to Game Update 172, Origin and Adaptive Augments were listed by rank from highest to lowest, and augments with the same rank were listed in alphabetical order.

sections.title: Notes
items: Severe Punishment activates a Rage mode that temporarily heals incoming damage for 8 seconds.
Rage Crash occurs immediately after the Rage mode ends and applies all damage that had been previously healed.
Shields and Damage Absorption abilities can be used to prevent some damage during a Rage Crash.

Vindictive is a supercharge that provides immunity to Rage Crash damage while active.

title: Shadow Curse
summary: Shadow Curse is a unique Iconic power unlocked via Event Progression. It is based on Ebon.

sections.title: Overview
items: Shadow Curse is a unique Iconic power unlocked via Event Progression. It is based on Ebon.

sections.title: Obtained from
items: Shadow Curse Iconic Ability item was obtainable from:
2025 Patrol 01: Shock to the System
A.R.G.U.S. Strike Team 2026

sections.title: Description
items: Unleash the Shadow Curse on your target and blast them with shadow energy. If the target is above 75% health, the attack deals extra damage.

sections.title: Details
items: [Ambush]
Vulnerable to Interrupt
Cooldown: 6s
Power Cost: 400
Range: 13m
Effect Area: Narrow Cone (22 degrees)
Superpower Modifier: 14 x5
Ambush Modifier: 17.5 x5
Activate Time: 2.4s

sections.title: Notes
items: Shadow Curse has a number of its parameters explicitly listed in the ability description.

It has a relatively short range of 13m. In comparison, ordinary ranged weapon basic attacks have a range of about 24m (which is also the range where the red targeting reticle on the targeted mob turns grey). There are some ranged abilities with shorter range though, like Ambush: Pain Blast (~11m).
It deals damage in a 22 degree cone (this is marginally narrower than 1/4 of a right angle). Shadow Curse will deal full damage to multiple targets up to at least 5 targets.

It has a Superpower Modifier listed as "14 x5" which is slightly misleading. As the in-game Stats page defines, Might determines the damage of superpowers - "Superpower Damage = Superpower Modifier * Might". Shadow Curse's Superpower Modifier under this definition is actually 0.14 x 5. Unlike most abilities, Shadow Curse's damage has no random variation and will always hit the exact same numbers under identical situations. In the absence of other effects, Shadow Curse will always hit 0.14 times of your Might stat 5 times (e.g. if you have 100000 Might, Shadow Curse will hit 14000 five times, or 70000 damage total).

It lists an Ambush modifier as 17.5 x5, but it is unknown what this indicates. If Shadow Curse is used to break Stealth, it deals one additional hit of damage (on the first enemy hit, not the specified target). This is considered to be damage dealt by the stealth ability (0.4x of Might for Invisibility), and thus has random variation and does not benefit from the 75% health damage bonus.
If the target is above 75% health, Shadow Curse deals 25% extra damage (each hit calculated separately).
Shadow Curse generates 41 Supercharge twice, on the 1st and 4th hit, for 82 total.

sections.title: Feats
items: I Was Always Gonna Flip, Hero: Collect the Shadow Curse Iconic Ability (100 points)

references.label: I Was Always Gonna Flip, Hero

sections.title: Trivia
items: It is based on one of Ebon's attacks in Shock: Abandoned Subway, and the feat for unlocking it references one of his lines in the instances.

Shadow Curse is the first Iconic Power to not be released at the beginning of the game, and the first to require being unlocked before it can be purchased. It is also the first to have a unique icon with a fixed palette that does not adapt to the theme of player Powers.
Voivode can use this ability in Raging Night: Aftershock.

title: Super Speed
summary: Chosen during Character Creation as a character's Movement Mode, Speedsters travel through the streets at an incredible velocity. Those with Superspeed movement reach such tremendous acceleration that they can run up the sides of buildings, up walls or across ceilings. Traveling long city blocks to get to the action becomes a cinch with this movement mode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Chosen during Character Creation as a character's Movement Mode, Speedsters travel through the streets at an incredible velocity. Those with Superspeed movement reach such tremendous acceleration that they can run up the sides of buildings, up walls or across ceilings. Traveling long city blocks to get to the action becomes a cinch with this movement mode.

A character is able to run around at blazing speeds and jump great distances when using the sides of buildings. A character can enter Super Speed mode by pressing "F" on the keyboard. In order to use the super jumping, the character must be running up the side of a building and pressing Jump.

At Level 9, Super Speed characters have the ability to enable their inherent Super Speed, where the character is able to run much faster than the default speed, but is unable to attack in this mode. Inherent Super Speed can be enabled by clicking "NumLock" on the keyboard.
There is also another ability purchased that transfers downward momentum into forward momentum while falling, which enhances the Super Jumping ability.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Some jump pads briefly turn your Movement Mode to Super Speed.
Primal Wolf Form of the Nature power transforms you into a wolf creature with Super Speed.
One of the missions in Central City involves The Flash giving the player character Super Speed for 3 minutes at a time to help civilians.
Non-lightning trail colors are based on the player's color palette.
The lightning trail of Super Speed always appears behind the player's back, even if they are moving backwards (e.g. by attacking an opponent while moving the opposite direction).

Due to various abilities, Super Speed is a significantly stronger movement mode for all roles than other movement modes, and is highly recommended for endgame content in DC Universe Online. Note that any temporary changes of movement modes do not grant access to their abilities; to use those, you must choose the desired movement mode at Character Creation or use a Respec Token: Movement Mode.

sections.title: Overview
items: Supply Drop is an Uplink Device type trinket activated by the Player Character to support them in combat. Lair System access is necessary to use these trinkets, to initialize them via the Base Mainframe, and to obtain them from the Base Dispenser. title: Telekinesis
summary: Telekinesis is a Mental power that becomes available at Level 1.

sections.title: Overview
items: Telekinesis is a Mental power that becomes available at Level 1.

sections.title: Description
items: Use your mind to lift your target into the air and damage it over time. While levitated, your enemy is helpless, and nearby objects are hurled at it.
Power Interactions : Dazes enemies, making them vulnerable to dazing effects.

sections.title: Details
items: Cooldown: 0.5s
Power Cost: 100

sections.title: Legs Equipment Mods
items: Legs Equipment Mods are available for this power:
Restorative Telekinesis

sections.title: Notes
items: Telekinesis can set up Telekinetic Bolt, Telekinetic Pull and Telekinetic Push for additional damage.

sections.title: Trivia
items: Environmental objects being hurled by Telekinesis deals white damage similar to an object physically thrown by a player, but does not scale with stats making the damage very low.

Telekinesis can hurl player-created objects, which can deal substantial ability (yellow) damage if it is intended by the original ability that created them, such as the Fire Boulder of the demon form in Kaznia City, or theoretically a Meteor created by another player with Fire.

Telekinesis can throw mobs encased by the player (e.g. Thought Bubble) as if they are objects. Curiously, if there is only one mob, which is encased, with no valid targets nearby, they are always hurled at the ground towards the east (if the encasement lasts long enough), regardless of position relative to the player.
Attackable objects than can be locked on will have objects hurled at them by Telekinesis, but would not take damage.

Vengeful Spirits in Metropolis and Agitated Spirits in Kaznia City have an ability similar to Telekinesis. They can also hurl objects - including player-created objects and encased mobs - at the player with similar caveats.

title: Amazo
summary: Amazo is an android whose special ability is to replicate the abilities of various superheroes and supervillains he comes into contact with. Amazo permanently replicated the powers and abilities of the first Justice League he encountered ( Green Lantern, Flash, Aquaman, Wonder Woman, Superman and the Martian Manhunter), making him a very powerful adversary in all subsequent appearances.

sections.title: Overview
items: Amazo is an android whose special ability is to replicate the abilities of various superheroes and supervillains he comes into contact with. Amazo permanently replicated the powers and abilities of the first Justice League he encountered ( Green Lantern, Flash, Aquaman, Wonder Woman, Superman and the Martian Manhunter), making him a very powerful adversary in all subsequent appearances.

sections.title: Background
items: The android Amazo was built by scientist Professor Ivo, who became obsessed with immortality. The original Justice League of America ( Green Lantern, Flash, Aquaman, Wonder Woman, and the Martian Manhunter) encountered Amazo after experiencing a sudden loss of their abilities. Discovering that certain long-lived creatures are being collected and realizing their powers have been stolen, the heroes split up to guard long-lived beings and battle Amazo but are defeated. Ivo is revealed to be the mastermind behind the scheme and, using data collected from the captured animal specimens, creates a potion that will bestow immortality. The plan, however, is foiled by Green Lantern, who recharges his ring and uses it to draw Amazo's powers away, before restoring them and the memories to the JLA. With Ivo defeated, Amazo was stored in the JLA's trophy room.

At the suggestion of Snapper Carr, the Justice League later reactivates Amazo to deal with an alien threat. The Justice League then defeats Amazo once again and returns the android to storage. When the Justice League lose their powers due to the machinations of the villain Libra, the heroes reactivate Amazo once again.

When radiation from an exploding red sun in deep space reaches Earth and weakens Superman significantly, the radiation also revives Amazo, who defeats the remainder of the Justice League, and imprisons them. Amazo then seeks out Ivo, wishing to be deactivated. Superman is forced to create and use a machine called the "Supermobile" to compensate for his weakened state. He battles Amazo and saves both Ivo, Lois Lane and the JLA. Ivo later reactivates Amazo again for use against a weaker version of the League, with the android defeating all the new members until finally stopped by the Martian Manhunter and Aquaman.
Various incarnations of Amazo were built, and conclusively destroyed, throughout the heroic age.

sections.title: Involvement

sections.title: Trivia
items: Amazo first appeared in The Brave and the Bold #30 (June 1960)

Ivo once used parts of Amazo along with human ova and DNA to create the android's "son". Awakened prematurely by an earthquake, the junior version of Amazo believes itself to be a philosophy student called Frank Halloran, who dates a girl called Sara. Amazo later reveals the truth to his progeny, who attempts to resist his programming by becoming a hero called "Kid Amazo". Slowly becoming insane, Kid Amazo confronted Ivo and discovered that Sara was Ivo's daughter and was placed to monitor the android. Batman deduces Kid Amazo has both the powers and the personalities of the JLA, and during a battle with the League creates dissension in the team that the android mimics, causing an internal logic error that destroys it.
He was first designated as "Amazeballs" by Jimmy Olsen, but was changed to Amazo right after since that name sounded ridiculous.
Amazo's pointed ears are actually antennas that the android uses to intake super powers.

sections.title: In-Game History
items: When Brainiac created and released a robotic replication of Joker onboard a captured STAR Labs Satellite, the robot's programing dictated that it hunt down and kill the original. Quickly locating the Joker and activating a teleporter, it teleported to this location in Arkham Asylum where the Joker was recovering from a toxin attack and trapped him in a stasis shield in order to continue copying the original's remaining persona before killing him.

The robot, however, was followed by a new villain, who was working under the Joker to track down T.O. Morrow. Using the location's security systems, the villain managed to defeat the robotic copy and free the original Joker from imprisonment, earning his trust as a full member of the Secret Society of Super-Villains.

title: Bailiff
summary: The baliff fight starts out easy enough. You start the fight by clearing out the braniac adds to get to the console that starts the fight. The baliff stays in his protective barrier while you the players try to bring kidnapped humans into his area.

sections.title: Overview
items: The baliff fight starts out easy enough. You start the fight by clearing out the braniac adds to get to the console that starts the fight. The baliff stays in his protective barrier while you the players try to bring kidnapped humans into his area.

The point of bringing in kidnapped humans is to fill a jury pool of humans, rather than let braniac adds fill the jury pool with braniac sparks. You can get a feat if you get all 12 jurors to be humans but you can fight the boss with just 7 humans.

How you get the humans to him is you must fight the bigger braniac adds that are carrying smaller braniac enemies. When you defeat them the smaller braniacs will vanish, and kidnapped humans will appear on opposite sids of the boss fight.

Be careful though because on the way bringing the humans to the baliff there are glowing squares that switch on and off. If you step on the square while it is glowing you will get electrocuted. The electrocution will not major damage but it will temporarily paralyze you.

To do this mission you need a team with all roles. It is the tanks job to go get the humans, and when the tank is not bringing in jurors he/she can pull the big braniac adds away from the baliff. To prevent braniac jurors from being added.
It is the job of the dps to kill the big braniac adds, and the trolls job to supply power to the dps, and the troller. The healer's job is to supply health, not to worry about doing damage!

The mini boss fight is simple, because the baliff does not do that much damage. If you wish to get the feat you must fill the jury pool to it's max with humans while the baliff is on the field. As I mentioned before the baliff does not do much damage so if your healer does his job no one should get downed but if anyone does get downed revive them immeditaly because if they die, they will not be able to rejoin the fight until either the baliff is dead, or the team gets ko'd.
The hardest part about this alert is getting the feat because if even a single braniac juror gets in the mix you will not get the feat.

sections.title: Background
items: Forged by former Guardians Ganthet and Sayd, the Blue Light of Hopes were made in preparation for the prophecy of the first Blackest Night, as the other Guardians ignored its coming. Channeling the light of hope, Blue Light of Hopes have an array of unique powers, such as:
Negating the powers and effects of red, yellow, orange, and gray lantern rings
Increasing the power of a green ring, or any other should they choose
Healing grievous injuries, physical or mental
Channeling the hope and belief of others
Showing someone's greatest hope
No need to recharge, as they draw on their own hope and ambient hope
Inspiring hope in others
Being close to the center of the Emotional Spectrum, the blue ring has little influence on its user's mind.

title: Helm of Nabu
summary: The Helm of Nabu, or the Helmet of Fate, is a mystical helmet of immense arcane power that is entrusted to the one chosen to be " Doctor Fate" by the Lord of Order Nabu.

sections.title: Overview
items: The Helm of Nabu, or the Helmet of Fate, is a mystical helmet of immense arcane power that is entrusted to the one chosen to be " Doctor Fate" by the Lord of Order Nabu.

As a mystical being whose soul was housed within the helmet, Nabu can communicate with "Doctor Fate" through the helm and bestow upon the Doctor his vast mystical power and wisdom. If he so wished it, Nabu could also possess the wearer; however, the wizard's abilities were later restricted to simply advising the wearer, unable to possess them.

sections.title: Involvement

sections.title: Associated Equipment

sections.title: Trivia
items: The Helm of Nabu first appeared in More Fun Comics #55 (May 1940).
According to Black Alice, the helm is "the most powerful magical artifact the world has ever known".
The helm is one of three powerful artifacts that Doctor Fate frequently utilizes; the other two are the Amulet of Anubis and the Cloak of Destiny. Together they are known as the "Artifacts of Fate".

While not fully sentient, the helmet is aware of the world around it in some fashion, and can respond to the mind of its holder. The helmet can put up a certain amount of resistance to those it doesn't want wearing it, making it a struggle for them to try and use its power.

The helmet has several protective enchantments on it. On several occasions, it was stolen by villains seeking the power of Doctor Fate; usually, the end result was that the wearer went insane when they tried to put on the helm.
